name: Bonneville Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232311 (96 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS campground (Boise NF, Lowman RD) about 19 mi E of Lowman off Hwy 21 at ~4,700 ft; 22 sites, ~18 RV/trailer-capable plus 4 walk-in tent-only, no hookups, vault toilets and drinking water. Warm Springs Creek runs alongside; South Fork Payette River across the highway; Bonneville Hot Springs a 1/4-mi hike above camp. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Cozy Cove Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234097 (47 days observed, edges closes)
note: Boise NF, SE shore of Deadwood Reservoir. 16 drive-in sites on a bluff overlooking the lake, vault toilets, drinking water, on-site boat ramp; no hookups. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Bull Trout Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232431 (96 days observed, edges closes)
note: Boise NF, on Bull Trout Lake off Hwy 21 near Banner Summit. 38 sites incl single/double, group and equestrian loops; trailers/RVs to 50 ft, vault toilets, drinking water; no hookups. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Hower's Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234098 (76 days observed, edges closes)
note: Boise NF, NE shore of Deadwood Reservoir (RV Life lists it as 'Homers'). 10 primitive drive-in sites with direct shoreline access, vault toilet, no hookups; nearest boat ramp ~5 mi at Cozy Cove. Reservable online. Temporarily closed mid-2026 for hazard-tree removal, expected to reopen. --Claude

name: Upper Payette Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234030 (101 days observed, edges closes)
note: Payette NF campground on Upper Payette Lake, ~16 mi N of McCall via Warren Wagon Rd; sites (listed to 30-78 ft), boat ramp and a paved shoreline trail. ~8 reservable + ~12 first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: O'Hara Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 231831 (158 days observed, edges closes)
note: Largest campground on the Selway River (32 tent/RV sites), Nez Perce-Clearwater NF, on the south bank via O'Hara Rd, ~7 mi up FR 223 from Lowell. Paved roads and parking spurs, chlorinated water, vault toilets, bear-resistant dumpsters; about one-third of sites along the river. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Powell Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233893 (132 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS (Nez Perce-Clearwater NF) campground on Road 102 a half-mile off US-12 near Lolo Pass, along the Lochsa Wild & Scenic River. 35 sites in two loops: Loop A has electric (15/30/50-amp), Loop B nonelectric; reservable on recreation.gov mid-May through Sept. Store, fuel and lodging within walking distance. --Claude

name: Huckleberry Campground (St. Joe River)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 273785 (327 days observed, edges closes)
note: BLM (Coeur d'Alene Field Office) campground on the St. Joe River, ~29 mi east of St. Maries near Calder. 33 sites: sites 1-30 single sites each with one paved spur + water/electric hookup, sites 31-33 group; vault toilets, RV dump station, non-motorized boat ramp. Reservable via recreation.gov (roughly May-Oct). --Claude

name: Devils Canyon Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232272 (205 days observed, edges closes)
note: Manti-La Sal NF campground 13 mi S of Monticello, 1/4 mi W off US-191; 41-42 single sites, paved parking spurs, vault toilets, seasonal drinking water, no hookups. Reservable online. Temporarily closed under a Forest Service location closure as of mid-2026 - verify status before booking. --Claude

name: King's Bottom Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10362432 (279 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: BLM campground on the Colorado River along paved Kane Creek Blvd, ~2.5 mi SW of Moab; 21 individual sites for tents & small RVs. Group site reservable online. --Claude
